queries.negative_balance: SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE balance_minor<0
queries.balance_conservation: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT u.id FROM users u LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.user_id=u.id AND p.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','PENDING') GROUP BY u.id,u.balance_minor HAVING u.balance_minor+coalesce(sum(p.amount_minor),0)<>1000000) t
queries.balance_vs_ledger_user: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT u.id FROM users u LEFT JOIN ledger_entries l ON l.account_type='USER' AND l.account_id=u.id GROUP BY u.id,u.balance_minor HAVING u.balance_minor-coalesce(sum(l.amount_minor),0)<>1000000) t
queries.agency_balance_vs_settlements: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT a.id FROM agencies a LEFT JOIN (SELECT NULL::bigint AS agency_id, 0::bigint AS net WHERE false) s ON s.agency_id=a.id WHERE a.settlement_balance_minor<>coalesce(s.net,0)) t
queries.orphan_user: SELECT count(*) FROM payments p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=p.user_id WHERE u.id IS NULL
queries.orphan_agency: SELECT count(*) FROM payments p LEFT JOIN agencies a ON a.id=p.agency_id WHERE a.id IS NULL
